detail: CAPGRID has raised ₹50 crore (~$5.2 million) from a fundraise led by Hero Enterprise Venture Partners with participation from existing investors Axilor Ventures, Anicut Capital, Nexus Venture Partners and other investors. Sarvaank Associates advised CAPGRID on this fundraise. The transaction was led by Ankita Singh (Managing Partner), with support from Yash Vardhan Singh (Partner), Sanchita Gupta (Senior Associate), Dipanjana Das (Senior Associate), Associates Ishaan Chakraborty and Mansi Gupta. CAPGRID CAPGRID is a Gurugram-based B2B manufacturing technology company that operates a technology-enabled cloud manufacturing and sourcing platform.
